\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item Find and graph the equation of the parabola with focus $(1,1)$ and
directrix $y=-1$.\\
\renewcommand{\ymax}{4}
\renewcommand{\ymin}{-4}
\renewcommand{\xmax}{4}
\renewcommand{\xmin}{-4}
%%%%%%%
\begin{tikzpicture} 
\begin{axis}[height=6cm, 
	width=6cm, 
	axis lines=middle,
	minor x tick num={1},
	minor y tick num={1},
	%xtick={0,50,...,250},
	%ytick={0,10,20,...,40},
	%grid=both,
	%axis line style={-latex}, 
	xmin=\xmin,xmax=\xmax, 
	ymin=\ymin,ymax=\ymax,
	%restrict y to domain=-1:10,
	%no markers, 
	xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$y$}, 
	%every axis x label/.append style={anchor=north}, 
	%every axis y label/.append style={anchor=east}
	]
	
\addplot[color=black,solid,mark=*] coordinates {(1,0)};
\addplot[color=black,solid,mark=*] coordinates {(1,1)} node[above] {focus};
\addplot[domain=\xmin:\xmax,thick,samples=100,draw=blue,dashed]{-1} node[below,xshift=-1cm] {directrix:} node[below,xshift=-1cm,yshift=-.5cm] {$y=-1$};
	\addplot[domain=\xmin:\xmax,thick,samples=1000,draw=red,<->]{1/4(x-1)^2} node[left] {$f(x)$};
	
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}\\
$y=\frac{1}{4p}\left(x-h\right)^{2}+k$ where the vertex is $\left(h,k\right)$
and the distance from the vertex to the focus is $p$.

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item The distance from the focus to the directrix is $1-\left(-1\right)=2$
so $p=\frac{1-\left(-1\right)}{2}=1$$\Rightarrow a=\frac{1}{4}$.
\item $k=1-p=0$ (the $y$-coordinate of the focus minus $p$)
\item $h=1$ (the $x$-coordinate of the focus)
\item So, $y=\frac{1}{4}\left(x-1\right)^{2}$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\item Find the focus and directrix of the parabola $y=\frac{1}{4}(x-1)^{2}+4$.\\
\renewcommand{\ymax}{10}
\renewcommand{\ymin}{0}
\renewcommand{\xmax}{10}
\renewcommand{\xmin}{-5}
%%%%%%%
\begin{tikzpicture} 
\begin{axis}[height=6cm, 
	width=6cm, 
	axis lines=middle,
	minor x tick num={4},
	minor y tick num={1},
	%xtick={0,50,...,250},
	%ytick={0,10,20,...,40},
	%grid=both,
	%axis line style={-latex}, 
	xmin=\xmin,xmax=\xmax, 
	ymin=\ymin,ymax=\ymax,
	%restrict y to domain=-4:6,
	%no markers, 
	xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$y$}, 
	%every axis x label/.append style={anchor=north}, 
	%every axis y label/.append style={anchor=east}
	]
	
addplot[color=black,solid,mark=*] coordinates {(1,4)};
\addplot[color=black,solid,mark=*] coordinates {(1,5)} node[above,xshift=5pt] {focus};
\addplot[domain=\xmin:\xmax,thick,samples=100,draw=blue,dashed]{3} node[below,xshift=-1cm] {directrix:} node[below,xshift=-1cm,yshift=-.5cm] {$y=3$};
	\addplot[domain=\xmin:\xmax,thick,samples=1000,draw=red,<->]{1/4*(x-1)^2+4} node[left] {$f(x)$};
	
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}\\
$a=\frac{1}{4}\Rightarrow\frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{4p}\Rightarrow p=1$,
and the vertex is $(1,4)$.

\begin{enumerate}
\item The focus is $\left(h,k+p\right)$: $\left(1,5\right)$
\item The directrix is $y=k-p$: $y=3$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}
